title: Statistical uncertainty model
help: Declare a first-order dependency model for one nominal value. Supply each estimate, sensitivity and every covariance entry explicitly. A sample covariance is not automatically an uncertainty of an estimate.
referenceHelp: Record the method reference in your own words or as a citation. It is retained with the model.
inputsHelp: Inputs have a stable order. Each sensitivity describes the change in the output for a change in that input at the declared evaluation point.
covarianceHelp: Enter every upper-triangle entry, including zero. The lower triangle is its symmetric counterpart. Omitted entries never imply independence.
covarianceCount: {count} saved entries; {required} required for these inputs
name: Input name
authoredHelp: Declare the unit and rationale for this exact value, including an intentional zero. Sensitivities use output/input difference units; covariance uses the product of input difference units.
pickerHelp: Choose a present, non-excluded numerical cell with a declared unit definition. Source spelling and declared units remain pinned to its revision.
invalidSource: This source must be a present, non-excluded numerical cell with a declared unit definition. Your model entries are retained.
retained: Retained value; inspect to page its exact spelling
busy: Working with the retained model. Your current entries are retained.
resourceHelp: These limits belong to the propagation. Source declarations retain their own limits. Resource refusal leaves the saved model and previous results available.
policyHelp: The variance is computed exactly. A perfect-square variance has an exact square root; otherwise the saved engine-4 policy governs the computational approximation. Display digits do not define the retained computational value.
noCoverage: This method propagates combined standard uncertainty from a declared first-order model. It does not assert a coverage interval, confidence level or distribution.
emptyCovariance: No covariance entries have been saved.
incomplete: Save the nominal value, rationale, evaluation point, all inputs and the complete upper triangle before propagation.
previewNote: Preview from the complete pinned dependency model. Retain the dataset to preserve its result and source receipt.
savedSources: Dataset sources retain their exact revisions. Editing this model creates a new revision and leaves earlier results available.
approximateInputs: At least one pinned input carries computational approximation provenance. Exact arithmetic here preserves the value of that retained approximation.
previewTruncated: This preview truncates long spellings. Retain the result, then inspect it to page the complete computational value.
historicalModel: This view preserves an earlier model revision. Its saved values and sources remain readable. Open the current model from Evidence & analysis to make a further amendment.
